versions.changelog:
- Initial release providing accurate, up-to-date download links and resource indexing for Khronos OpenCL standards, headers, SDK, CTS, and recommended community tools.
- Clearly distinguishes official Khronos resources and third-party/community tools, with explicit attribution.
- Includes categorized official API/specification docs, GitHub resources, developer portals, and support links.
- Supplies reference implementation details, example usage, and command-line scripts for one-click resource setup.
- Offers guidance on local directory structure and resource maintenance best practices.
